published_title: The Jack in the Box AKA I Popped a 7 (QMC)
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''choker''') posted a [[Light]] [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]] list on DeckTech in July 2001.
description: A unique QMC deck that employs recycling of destiny 7's to wreck the opponent.  EPPs becomes more than a menace with such high destiny to bring more bang to their weapons...literally.
cards: posted: Heading for the Medical Frigate
posted: Cloud City Guest Quarters (Leia's Domain)
posted: Keeping the Empire Out Forever
posted: Qui-Gon x2 (AKA Dark Jedi Killer)
posted: Path of Least Resistance x3
notes: Posted 10 July 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting Jank...': Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation (posted 'QMC/IO'), Heading For The Medical Frigate, Bespin, Cloud City: Guest Quarters (posted 'Cloud City Guest Quarters (Leia's Domain)'), Squadron Assignments, Keeping The Empire Out Forever and Menace Fades; these count toward the 60.
Section headers ('The Cast...', 'The Toys...', 'The Stuff...', 'The Helpers...', 'The Order...', 'The Set...', 'The Fireworks...') are not cards.

Posted 'EPP Luke/Obi/Han/Leia' dested Luke With Lightsaber, Obi-Wan With Lightsaber, Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol and Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Naked Threepio' Threepio With His Parts Showing; 'Wedge, RSL' Wedge Antilles, Red Squadron Leader; 'Padme' Padme Naberrie; 'Qui-Gon (AKA Dark Jedi Killer)' the Tatooine Qui-Gon Jinn.
Posted 'Red 8 (read strat)' dested the Special Edition starship Red 8 (the strategy says it adds to X-wing Laser Cannon draws); 'Artoo in Red 5' dested Artoo-Detoo In Red 5.

Posted 'CC Platform 327' dested Cloud City: Platform 327 (Docking Bay) (the strategy mentions the docking bay); 'CC Carbo Chamber' dested Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber; 'CC Celebration' Cloud City Celebration.
Posted 'Surprise Assualt' dested Surprise Assault (Premiere) as written; the strategy later mentions 'The Counter Assualt', which may mean a different card, but the list names Surprise Assault.
Posted 'Nebruin Leids' dested Nabrun Leids; 'Jinn's Lightsaber' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (the deck plays Qui-Gon Jinn); 'Intruder Missle' dested Intruder Missile.
The strategy is signed Michael "Spider Monkey" Sorrell; the byline handle is 'choker', which the existing player page already uses.
